chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhiogi' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-leem gu Judaa ka't gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu u'vɨ gook gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't gu Elimelek gu u'vɨ gu Noemi; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu Maaloon gu Kelioon gu Eprateos gu Bet-leem gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu Moab.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Elimelek gu chio'ñ gu Noemi gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu u'vɨ gu Moab gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Orpa gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Rut; gio ba' jix daa mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix koko' gio gook gu Maaloon gu Kelioon gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu Moab; na gu' jix kai yooxi' gu Moab gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ja'tkam na ba' jix maa gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix buus pai' ka't dhi' bɨɨx gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua'da' jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Noemi jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' no'ñ tu' gu ma'nkam vook bɨpna'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' nɨɨra no'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu tukaa' jum duu bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm bhaai'n jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam cham ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; na jix gɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim no'ñ tu' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Orpa bakxidhat gu' gu Rut bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' tu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Rut jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dɨlhkob tu'; na gu' pai' tu' tu jiim tu'; jano' ba' pai' duaka'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ka't gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' tu' vaak jodai koi tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa koi'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Noemi ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem; gio ba' ka't baakɨk gu Bet-leem bɨx kiicham am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr cham gu Noemi.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Noemi gu ñi'ook mɨmɨim gu Mara; na gu' jix gɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu' jix bhai'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mɨmɨim gu Noemi tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa chuut bhaan tu' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Noemi gu Rut gu Moabita bɨɨx; gio ba' vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu Bet-leem gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' gu Teniia gu Noemi jir bɨx bhai' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu Elimelek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Boos.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rut gu Moabita gu Noemi; gio ba' gu Rueegote gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' yooxi' kaipgaidhat mii' dhɨr gu vupui bakia' nɨidhidha'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'; gio ba' ka't yooxi' ka't gu Boos ka't gu Elimelek.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Boos suudai' u'va gu Bet-leem; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Boos jix duñia' daam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' daam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Moab bɨɨx gu Noemi vaak ja'tkam gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui dɨr gu ñi'ook gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm jano' gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Boos gu Rut; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ cham yooxi' tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam yooxi'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' cham tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook tu' i'i gu suudai' jix buusñi.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui na ba' tu' jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Boos; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' tu' jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bakxidhat mi' dhɨr koi'm gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan gu oidha' pai' tɨbiap gu ja'tkam cham va'k.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tɨbiap na ba' bɨtaa'n.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam na tu juan cham tu' na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu Boos gu tas jugi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chin jɨ'ɨɨk; mi' dhɨr jix daa ju'ñdharan jix maa jix jugi bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' jix búup na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Boos jix aa'ñdhix bham; mi' dhɨr gio kaipgaidhat tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai ka't na ja'p gu Epa kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ suudai' u'va kiicham; gio ba' bakxidhat jix ñi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi gio ka't mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' bakxidhat; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook duukat ka't tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bakxidhat ka't bɨɨx jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Boos.

Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' ko'iix jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Noemi; jano' ba' chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rut gu Moabita; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx oraa'.
Jano' ba' gu Noemi jix aa' gu Rut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tutkɨ mar u'vɨ bɨɨx cham tu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Boos bɨɨx ka'm oraa' kai' vaas gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' bɨɨx bakxidhat jix daa.
Jano' ba' gu Diijole bakxidhat gu Noemi; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu Boos chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu Miren dhi' gu tukaa' kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jajannulhi'ñ ka't; gu' cham tu' maa'n jix maati' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook jugi i'i.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' jix duñia' tu' tɨɨt tu'; gio ba' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix dhaav ka't tu' bɨx bakxidhat ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Boos ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ juruuñ koox gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk; gio ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va jix ñi'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't ɨraab gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu u'vɨ ka't tɨɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Rut gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; na gu' muuk jannulhi'ñ bhaan gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na gu' jir bɨx bhai' mia'n.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios mar u'vɨ; na gu ñi'ook tutkɨ nɨidhidha' cham jiimchu' bhaan biipibop ka't bia' chutumñigam.
Jano' ba' jano' cham jum i'obh mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bɨndak tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx ki'ñgob gu ja'tkam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' tu' jix duñia' jir bɨx bhai' mia'n bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch jir bɨx bhai' mia'n tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tukaa' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tanoolh tu' xoi'kam; gu' tu' cham tu' tu jiim tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix utu'ñ tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix búup va'k soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maati'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't tɨbiap gu u'vɨ ka't.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' kai' vaas; jano' ba' suudai' u'va kiicham.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va bakxidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook bɨx bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kai' vaas jix maa tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham jix bhai'x bakxidhat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Noemi; gio ba' jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Boos jix tɨ'ɨ ki'ñgob jix daa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu Boos tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix bhai'x xanoop; jano' ba' suudai' u'va jix daa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ daraa kiicham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix dhadhaa.
Ba' jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' yooxi' gu Moab bi'iix baasɨ'n jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu Elimelek.

Jano' ba' tu' ja'xñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim vupui bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu jiim na ba' tu'; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook tu' mi' dhɨr tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Boos; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu Noemi gio gu Rut gu Moabita gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix koi bhaan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim baasɨ'n na gu' gu maa'nkar; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' cham tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'n duiñchu'; gio ba' dhi' ka't chuut gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu Boos; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Boos daraa bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix bɨɨx duu gu Elimelek bɨx ka't gu Kelioon gu Maaloon gu novɨ gu Noemi.

Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Rut gu Moabita gu u'vɨ gu Maaloon na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu maa'nkar na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix koi cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ki'ñgob pai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p bɨx gu ja'tkam mi'p ki'ñgob bɨɨx daraa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ ba'k gu vaak na ja'p gu Rakêl gu Leea gook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' gu Eprata gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu kai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Pares gu Tamar gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Boos jix bhɨɨ gu Rut ka't gu u'vɨ; gio ba' chɨbiapui gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ am:―Ja'pji gu Noemi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duu cham tu' uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' xoi'kam tu' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu ma'nkam tu'.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Noemi gu mar jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham gu Noemi tu' maaxir gu mar jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' tɨɨt gu Obed; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu taat gu Isaii gu taat gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Pares; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu esroon.
Jano' ba' gu esroon jix mar gu Ram jix mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu Aminadab jix mar gu Naasoon jix mar gu Salmoon.
Jano' ba' gu Salmoon jix mar gu Boos jix mar gu Obed.
Jano' ba' gu Obed jix mar gu Isaii tu' gu Isaii jix mar gu Dabii.
